lines.text: Lebanon is told to open its doors for fire, and the oaks of Bashan are told to wail.
The LORD tells the prophet to pasture the flock marked for slaughter, and he takes two staffs, Favor and Union.
The prophet dismisses seven shepherds in one month and cuts the staff Favor, revoking the covenant with all the nations.
They weigh out thirty silver pieces as wages, and the prophet throws them to the high priest.
Woe falls on the worthless shepherd who deserts the flock, and a sword is to strike his arm and eye.
